bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 169, Number 24 (Monday, February 6, 2023)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. BURGESS:
H.R. 829.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Pursuant to Article I Section 8 of the United States'
Consitution. Congress has the power to enact this
legislation.
The single subject of this legislation is:
This legislation complies with the single subject criteria
as it only concerns the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.
[Page H710]
